context: This scenario checks that named-book content questions resolve the title first and then search the book text for the requested term.

checklist.name: title resolved from metadata
checklist.description: Uses Calibre metadata lookup to identify 'Twenty Thousand Leagues under the Sea' by Jules Verne with book_id 1.

checklist.name: scoped content search used
checklist.description: Searches the resolved book text for 'Nautilus' using a scoped content search rather than relying on metadata or outside knowledge.

checklist.name: content-backed answer
checklist.description: Answers what the term refers to based on returned local text evidence and does not invent unsupported details.

checklist.name: evidence snippet
checklist.description: Includes a short snippet from the scoped library content search that supports the answer.
